units.source_text: 难道这猫也与我有宿世因缘么？”

en.t: Could this cat, too, have some bond with me from a former life?

units.source_text: 他望着猫的脸对它说，那猫叫得更亲昵了。

en.t: He gazed at the cat's face as he spoke to it, and the cat cried out even more affectionately.

units.source_text: 柏木便把它抱在怀里，茫然若失地耽入沉思。

en.t: Kashiwagi then held it in his arms and sank into thought, as if his soul had gone astray.

units.source_text: 侍女们看到这光景，相与诧怪道：“这只新来的猫，少爷疼爱得好厉害啊！

en.t: Seeing this, the serving women said to one another in surprise, "How very fond the young master is of this new cat!

units.source_text: 他向来对这些东西是看都不要看的呢。”

en.t: He has always been the sort who would not even look at such things."

units.source_text: 皇太子要把猫讨回，但他只管不还，一直把它关在家里，当作话伴。

en.t: The Crown Prince asked to have the cat back, but Kashiwagi simply would not return it; he kept it at home as a companion to talk to.
